shellCommands.command: ls -la && echo "---PACKAGE---" && cat package.json && echo "---GIT---" && git log --oneline -5
ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null && echo "---" && cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'
find app -type f | head -50 && echo "---CONFIG---" && cat next.config.ts
for f in app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx app/loading.tsx app/CardStats.tsx app/LatestInvoices.tsx app/RevenueChart.tsx; do echo "===== $f ====="; cat "$f"; echo; done
grep -rl -i "cacheComponents\|cache components\|use cache\|partial prerender\|partial pre-render" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/ 2>/dev/null
rm -rf .next && timeout 240 npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40

find .next -name "*.html" -path "*server*" 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---"; find .next -name "index.html" 2>/dev/null | head; echo "--- grep shell ---"; grep -rl "Dashboard" .next/server 2>/dev/null | head

grep -o '

Dashboard

' .next/server/app/index.html | head -1; echo "--- skeleton present in shell? ---"; grep -o 'dashboard-skeleton\|skeleton-text\|Total Revenue\|Latest Invoices' .next/server/app/index.html | sort -u; echo "--- real data should NOT be in shell ---"; grep -c 'api.example.com' .next/server/app/index.html
